expenditures.detail: FLOOR, delta 938.50. 22 of the 24 expenditure rows are legible and sum to 52,524.45; the amount cells of rows 14 and 15 print DATE STRINGS ('24-Oct' and '1-Oct') - an Excel cell-format defect in the filer's own spreadsheet - so those two amounts are unparseable and were left blank per the malformed-figure rule. The residual 938.50 exactly equals the two Schedule A in-kind party rows of the same 6-Oct date and same purposes (298.29 File preparation + 640.21 Postage), which is corroborating evidence of what the two cells hold, but no value was written into them. itemized.page_subtotal_gates: Neither attachment prints a SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE line - the itemization is a filer spreadsheet, not the form's grid, so the page-subtotal gate CANNOT fire on p4 or p6. The gate applied instead was each attachment's own printed grand total: p4 rows sum 40,015.50 = printed 'CONTRIBUT $ 40,015.50' (PASS); p6 legible rows sum 52,524.45 vs printed 'EXPENSES $ 53,462.95' (FAILS BY 938.50 - cause named above, no row adjusted). The blank Schedule A/B form pages 3 and 5 print empty SUBTOTAL/TOTAL cells.
itemized.escalation_note: p4 and p6 are LANDSCAPE attachments; both re-rendered at 300dpi and rotated 90 deg counter-clockwise with PIL, then split into left/right halves so the Read tool would not downsample below ~235 effective dpi. A 600dpi re-crop of p6 was attempted but the crop frame missed the table; the 300dpi rotated read was retained and cross-checked by arithmetic instead.
itemized.notes: PAGE ORDER: p3 = blank Schedule A form with 'See attached'; p4 = the contributions spreadsheet (landscape); p5 = blank Schedule B form with 'See attached'; p6 = the expenditures spreadsheet (landscape). The spreadsheets carry an 'Address' COLUMN HEADER but the filer left every address cell empty, so donor_city/donor_state are blank on all 21 contribution rows (filer omission, not redaction). Every date on both attachments is printed day-month with NO YEAR ('22-Sep', '2-Oct'), so no date is cleanly parseable to ISO; all left blank with the verbatim in the row note, per the never-fill-a-year-from-the-report-date rule. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: p4 has 21 dates / 21 amounts / 21 contributor names / 21 occupation cells / 21 type cells - PASS. p6 has 24 dates / 24 amount cells / 24 payees / 24 purposes - the COUNTS match, but two amount cells hold date strings; that is a cell-FORMAT defect in the source, not a column shift (the payee and purpose columns stay aligned, confirmed by the two rows' distinctive purposes 'File preparation' and 'Postage' matching the same-dated Schedule A party rows). GEOMETRY IS OMITTED on every row of both attachment pages: they are landscape scans and my portrait-frame back-conversion of the row bands could not be pinned closer than the row pitch, so a pointer would be worse than none. The attachment 'Type' column marks four contribution rows 'In Kind'; two further party rows carry the non-cash type strings 'File preparation' and 'Postage' with no 'In Kind' words - those are recorded in_kind=false with the verbatim type in the note, because the form does not mark them in-kind.
